# Final WABON Reviewer Dashboard

A read-only portal that lets the Board of Nursing check every requirement against live data from the student, instructor and admin sides, with plain-language instructions for each page and click.

Aliko Academy · Health · CNA (NA-C) Training Program

Audience: Aliko team (to build) · WABON nursing education consultant (to use)

Based on a live walkthrough of lms.alikohub.com (Nov 23, 2026), the WABON Common Curriculum (Units

1–9) and WAC 246-841A (effective July 1, 2026)

Version 1.0 · November 23, 2026

## Why a WABON dashboard

WABON needs to see that the course students take is the approved course, that online theory meets the asynchronous standards, that class sizes and the 3-month limit are respected, that tests verify identity, and that skills and clinical hours are signed by approved RNs. Today that evidence is spread across student, instructor and admin pages, some of which are not finished. The reviewer dashboard puts it in one read-only place, built from the same data.

## How a reviewer moves through it (plain language)

1. Sign in. The Admin sends an invitation (Admin › WABON Reviewer Access). The reviewer sets a password and lands on Overview. A yellow badge at the top says "Read-only review access · all views logged".

2. Start on Overview. Seven colored rows show each rule area. Green = met, orange = open. Click a row to jump to its evidence page.

3. Check the course. Open Curriculum & Units to see the 9 units, then Open › on any unit to see every item and its minutes. Course Player (read-only) lets the reviewer click through lessons exactly as a student does, without submitting anything.

4. Check the cohort. Use Cohorts & Ratios, Attendance & Seat-Time and Assessments & Integrity. Pick a cohort from the drop-down at the top right. Click a student row to see their day-by-day log (names can be masked).

5. Check hands-on training. Skills Lab Records and Clinical Records list every check-off and shift.   
Click a skill or shift to see the signed checklist and the RN who signed it.

6. Check people and sites. Faculty Credentials and Clinical Facilities open each license check and agreement.

7. Download or ask. Evidence Locker builds fresh PDFs/CSVs. Requests & Findings lets the reviewer send a question; the program answers in the same thread, and open items show on Overview.

## W1 · Reviewer Overview — the whole program on one page

How to use: the reviewer signs in with a read-only account created by the Admin (Admin → WABON Reviewer Access). Every page is view-only and every click is logged. The left menu goes from the program, to the course, to cohort evidence, to people and sites, to files.
